name: grimoire
description: A spellbook of plugins for Claude Code and Codex. Each plugin is a book; archmage is the required reading.

plugins.name: archmage
plugins.description: Required reading for the grimoire: teaches the agent how to use grimoire plugins and how to bind new books.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: One line above the prompt: context tokens with their weather, a bar per recent prompt, your 5-hour and 7-day limits against the time elapsed, the prompt cache with its time left, the session cost and the agents running. Labels in English or Korean. A port of token-weather-usage by Eric Cologni (Apache-2.0).
